summary: A downward stone-to-flesh spell hits a non-headstone floor engraving. C reports that the floor edges smooth and wipes the engraving with d(2,4); zap_map in JavaScript omits this spell arm, so it leaves the engraving unchanged and skips the damage roll.

source.branch: zap_map(): for u.dz > 0, when the target has a non-headstone engraving and the object is SPE_STONE_TO_FLESH, C acts only on ENGRAVE: it prints the hallucination-dependent smoothing message and wipes d(2,4) characters. Other engraving types are unchanged.
callers: zap.c:zap_updown() -> zap_map() after the downward spell's floor-pile handling

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/zap.c:3670-3676: the downward engraving switch handles SPE_STONE_TO_FLESH only when e->engr_type == ENGRAVE, prints the smoothing message, and calls wipe_engr_at(x, y, d(2,4), TRUE).
js/zap.js:4040-4075: zap_map() has the downward and non-headstone gates but no SPE_STONE_TO_FLESH arm, so it neither emits the message nor calls wipe_engr_at or consumes the d(2,4) roll.
